turns.content: Compare the pre-existing disease waiting period of Health Secure Plus and Family Care Gold.

gold_answer: Health Secure Plus: 36 months for declared pre-existing diseases. Family Care Gold: 48 months for pre-existing disease unless reduced by endorsement.

turns.content: How does maternity cover differ between Maternity Protect and Critical Care Elite?

gold_answer: Maternity Protect: covered after a 24 month waiting period (eligible delivery expenses, medically necessary C-section and defined newborn benefits, subject to sub-limits). Critical Care Elite: not covered under the base critical illness plan.

turns.content: Is drunk driving excluded under both Two Wheeler Secure and Motor Protect Comprehensive?

gold_answer: Yes, under both. Two Wheeler Secure excludes Drunk driving; Motor Protect Comprehensive excludes Intoxication.

turns.content: Compare the claim procedure of Car Shield Plus with Two Wheeler Secure.

gold_answer: Car Shield Plus: Cashless repair available only at empanelled garages subject to authorization. Two Wheeler Secure: Vehicle inspection may be required before repair approval.

turns.content: Which cover amounts do Senior Health Shield and Global Travel Secure offer, side by side?

gold_answer: Senior Health Shield: ₹2,00,000, ₹5,00,000 or ₹10,00,000. Global Travel Secure: ₹5,00,000 or ₹10,00,000 equivalent limits.
